    def __init__(self, notification: 'Notification', hub: 'INotificationHub', scheduler: 'SchedulerBase', lifespan: 'timedelta | None' = None, tick_interval: 'timedelta | None' = None) -> 'None'
    property approve_command [get] -> RelayCommand
    property reject_command [get] -> RelayCommand
  class INotificationHub(Protocol)
    property pending [get] -> Observable[list[Notification]]
    def post(self, notification: 'Notification') -> 'asyncio.Future[NotificationReaction]'
    def resolve(self, notification: 'Notification', reaction: 'NotificationReaction') -> 'None'
  NULL_NOTIFICATION_HUB: NullNotificationHub
  class Notification(object)
    def __init__(self, type: 'NotificationType', message: 'str') -> 'None'
    property message [get] -> str
    property type [get] -> NotificationType
  class NotificationHub(object)
    def __init__(self) -> 'None'
    def dispose(self) -> 'None'
    property pending [get] -> Observable[list[Notification]]
    def post(self, notification: 'Notification') -> 'asyncio.Future[NotificationReaction]'
    def resolve(self, notification: 'Notification', reaction: 'NotificationReaction') -> 'None'
  class NotificationReaction(Enum)
    member APPROVE = 2
    member PENDING = 1
    member REJECT = 3
  class NotificationType(Enum)
    member CONFIRMATION = 3
    member ERROR = 1
    member NOTIFICATION = 2
  class NotificationVM(object)
    def __init__(self, notification: 'Notification', hub: 'INotificationHub', scheduler: 'SchedulerBase', lifespan: 'timedelta | None' = None, tick_interval: 'timedelta | None' = None) -> 'None'
    property dismiss_command [get] -> RelayCommand
    def dispose(self) -> 'None'
    property is_resolved [get] -> bool
    property lifespan [get] -> timedelta
    property notification [get] -> Notification
    def notify_external_resolve(self) -> 'None'
    property opacity [get] -> float
    property property_changed [get] -> rx.Observable[str]
    property remaining_time [get] -> timedelta
  class NullNotificationHub(object)
    def __init__(self) -> 'None'
    property pending [get] -> Observable[list[Notification]]
    def post(self, notification: 'Notification') -> 'asyncio.Future[NotificationReaction]'
    def resolve(self, notification: 'Notification', reaction: 'NotificationReaction') -> 'None'
  def make_confirm(hub: 'INotificationHub', prompt: 'str') -> 'Callable[[], Awaitable[bool]]'

module vmx.properties
  DerivedProperty = vmx.DerivedProperty
  from_five = vmx.from_five
  from_four = vmx.from_four

  from_one = vmx.from_one
  from_sources = vmx.from_many
  from_three = vmx.from_three
  from_two = vmx.from_two

module vmx.services
  Dispatcher = vmx.Dispatcher
  MessageHub = vmx.MessageHub
  MessageHubProto = vmx.MessageHubProto
  NULL_DISPATCHER: NullDispatcher
  NULL_MESSAGE_HUB: NullMessageHub
  NullDispatcher = vmx.NullDispatcher
  NullMessageHub = vmx.NullMessageHub
  RxDispatcher = vmx.RxDispatcher
  TransactionalMessageHubProto = vmx.TransactionalMessageHubProto
  def null_message_hub_of(message_type: 'type[TMessage]') -> 'TransactionalMessageHubProto[TMessage]'

module vmx.state
  AsyncResourceError = vmx.AsyncResourceError
  AsyncResourceErrorWithValue = vmx.AsyncResourceErrorWithValue
  AsyncResourceIdle = vmx.AsyncResourceIdle
  AsyncResourceLoading = vmx.AsyncResourceLoading
  AsyncResourceLoadingWithValue = vmx.AsyncResourceLoadingWithValue
  AsyncResourceReady = vmx.AsyncResourceReady
  AsyncResourceRetention = vmx.AsyncResourceRetention
  alias AsyncResourceState = typing.Union[vmx.state.async_resource_vm.AsyncResourceIdle[~T], vmx.state.async_resource_vm.AsyncResourceLoading[~T], vmx.state.async_resource_vm.AsyncResourceLoadingWithValue[~T], vmx.state.async_resource_vm.AsyncResourceReady[~T], vmx.state.async_resource_vm.AsyncResourceError[~T], vmx.state.async_resource_vm.AsyncResourceErrorWithValue[~T]]
  AsyncResourceStatus = vmx.AsyncResourceStatus
  AsyncResourceVM = vmx.AsyncResourceVM
  DiscriminatorVM = vmx.DiscriminatorVM

module vmx.tree
